host.ask: IP address or host name of the Interface I-300 Pro (Settings > Network on the interface)
host.help: The I-300 Pro must have 'Rotavapor Open Interface' enabled (Settings > Rotavapor Open Interface) and been restarted after enabling it.

password.ask: OpenInterface password for the read/write user 'rw' (shown on the I-300 Pro when the interface is enabled)

user.ask: OpenInterface user (rw for control, ro for read only)

verify_tls.ask: Check the interface's TLS certificate? (needs ca_cert set to Büchi's root_cert.crt)

ca_cert.ask: Path to Büchi's root_cert.crt when verify_tls is true
